Good to know

Frequently asked questions

What is NovusLease+ car rental service?+
NovusLease+ is a premium self-drive brand offering clean, well-maintained cars on short-term rental — daily, weekly, fortnightly — or monthly subscription. Enjoy unbeatable rates, quick online booking, unlimited kilometres, limited liability, and anywhere delivery.
Is NovusLease+ available in my city?+
We operate across 16 cities and 100+ locations in India, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kochi and Ahmedabad. Enter your city in the booking widget to check live availability.
What documents do I need to rent a car?+
A valid driving licence, a government-issued ID (Aadhaar/passport), and a quick online KYC verification are all you need to hit the road.
How does the kilometre limit work?+
Choose from 120 kms, 300 kms, or unlimited-km packages based on your travel needs. Extra kilometres beyond your package are billed at a transparent per-km rate shown upfront at booking.
Can I get the car delivered to me?+
Yes — select doorstep, airport, hub, or nearest SPOC location delivery at checkout, whichever is most convenient for you.
